liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Stella Blue** (3 reviews): The performance is described as stunning, demonstrating great inventiveness and precision; The reviewer identifies this performance as a keeper, noting Franklin's Tower is also good [9][13][16]
- **Lazy Lightnin'** (1 review): Reviewer highlights this specific jam as a favorite from the late seventies [7]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): The jam lasted thirteen minutes, with Jerry noodling in space before the next song [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-01-30.sbd.miller.32255.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 161 min; rated 4.38/5 by 16 [1]. Said about its sound: Keith's keyboard produces an annoying banging sound that ruins the solo [10]
- **gd1978-01-30.148564.sbd.latvala.wise.miller.clugston.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 161 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1978-01-30.164896.sony.ecm99.powell.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 20 songs; 152 min [3]
- **gd1978-01-30.164895.akg.gale.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 157 min [4]

## Around the show

- The band maintained positive energy, though setlists were becoming fairly predictable by early 1978 [11]
- Reviewer entered via service door, got passes from Jerry, and watched from behind crates [12]
- Bobby suggested returning the next night after the three-day run at the small theater [12]
- Keith's playing was percussive, which was unnecessary for a band with two drummers [14]
- Phil thanked the crowd after an extra effort performance of the song [15]
- A nineteen-year-old drove through an Ohio blizzard to attend the Chicago show [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-01-30.sbd.miller.32255.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Audio disks from Jim Wise; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD -> FLAC [1]. Also: Charlie Miller and colleagues remastered the soundboard recording to optimize audio quality; Charlie Miller and team provided a super cleaned up version of the 1978 soundboard [7][11]
- **gd1978-01-30.148564.sbd.latvala.wise.miller.clugston.flac16**: taped by Dick Latvala; transferred by Jim Wise, Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Soundboard Reel > Dick Latvala's Dat (16/44.1) [2]. Also: Sony ECM99 source supplies crowd noise and the beginning of Promised Land [2]
- **gd1978-01-30.164896.sony.ecm99.powell.mckenzie.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Tim Powell;Tim McKenzie; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Tim Powell's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM 99 mics > Sony TC-152 cassette deck > 1st Generation Reels > DAT (16/48) [3]. Also: This alternate transfer eliminates the CD generation present in the previous version [3]
- **gd1978-01-30.164895.akg.gale.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Unknown from the collection of Dan Gale; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Low Gen audience recording; AKG mics, from the Dan Gale collection [4]. Also: Sony ECM99 source supplies a twenty-two second patch in Eyes Of The World [4]
